faqs.a:
This chapter shall be known and cited as
chapter 14
, the "Arvada Animal Management Ordinance." When citing the provisions of this article
               in any summons, subpoena, pleading, summons and complaint, or other document, it shall
               be sufficient to make reference to this chapter, along with any specific section,
               if necessary.
(Code 1981, § 6-2; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998;
Ord. No. 4028, § 1, 10-16-2006
)
